# connected components in INPUT of non-zero.
from collections import deque
H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
comps=[]
for i in range(H):
    for j in range(W):
        if I[i][j] and not seen[i][j]:
            q=deque([(i,j)]); seen[i][j]=True; cells=[]; col=None
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft(); cells.append((y,x))
                c=I[y][x]
                if col is None: col=c
                for dy,dx in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    yy,xx=y+dy,x+dx
                    if 0<=yy<H and 0<=xx<W and I[yy][xx]==c and not seen[yy][xx]:
                        seen[yy][xx]=True; q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append((col,cells))
print('input comps:')
for col,cells in comps:
    rows=[r for r,c in cells]; cols=[c for r,c in cells]
    print(col, min(rows),max(rows),min(cols),max(cols), len(cells))
# blocks (3x3 or larger) colors:
blks=[(col,(min(r for r,_ in cs),max(r for r,_ in cs),min(c for r,c in cs),max(c for r,c in cs))) for col,cs in comps if len(cs)>=4]
